reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a globe centered on South America, making it ideal for tasks about Latin America, world geography, international travel, localization, or general web/global topics. It is slightly less distinctive than a gridded wireframe globe and at tiny sizes the upper-left isthmus could briefly look like a diagonal prohibition slash.
